short: 3D-conv + ResNet + Bi-LSTM (M06) and three-stage per-step training (M03) are standard: no prior LRW work, single runs; 6.8-point SOTA margin is unmatched; 83.0% trails 93.2% today.
position: The paper [@stafylakis2017resnetlstm] changes the processing chain (M06), one 3D convolution layer, a per-frame ResNet-34 and a two-layer Bi-LSTM, and the training recipe (M03), three stages with the word loss at every time step. Both are standard: the LRW benchmark [@chung2016lrw] is [concurrent] and the ledger holds 0 prior LRW studies (Appendix), so nothing can be behind, and every ablation is one run on one test set, so nothing qualifies as ahead. The design is now the field's default: 106 of 156 LRW / LRW-1000 ledger keys name 3D convolution and a ResNet together, and 115 a recurrent back end (pattern match, Appendix). The main overreach is the Abstract's 6.8-point state-of-the-art margin: the comparator [@chung2017was] [concurrent] was pretrained on extra BBC sentence data, which §2 concedes and the Abstract omits, and §5.1 gives it as 74.2% where §2 and §6 give 76.2%. Today 83.0% sits 10.2 points below SyncVSR [@ahn2024syncvsr] [later] without word boundaries (inference).
